bio: Everything about this inviting restaurant makes it clear that Luella and Madelene are passionate about what they do. Luella likes nothing better than to amaze her guests with her contemporary surprise menu. Her dishes revolve around a main ingredient of the finest quality, elaborate garnishes and velvety sauces that bring it all together. The wines recommended by Madelene complement the intense flavours beautifully. This duo's enthusiasm is infectious!...
